capabilities: Format code blocks with bundled Prettier, including blocks in lists and callouts
Run JavaScript and TypeScript blocks in a Web Worker with console output
Open code blocks in VS Code via vscode:// links
Edit inside code blocks with language-aware indentation, brackets, and comment toggling
Underline the first syntax error in a supported block
extras: Not yet in the community plugin list; manual installation from release files is required. The README includes security and privacy disclosures: on desktop, run blocks get Node.js access and are not sandboxed.
problem: Obsidian's editor offers little code-block-specific help: no one-click formatting, no way to run code in a note, and generic editing keys inside fenced blocks.

relations.evidence: Toggle comment works by wrapping Obsidian's own Toggle comment command, so it follows whatever hotkey you gave

summary: Code block toolkit that formats fenced code blocks with Prettier, runs JavaScript and TypeScript in place, and adds code-block editing keys.
